data.question: Is this really everything? What's included?
data.answer: Yes. Every knowledge product currently available: [Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit) (**€149.99** value), [Knowledge Management for Beginners](/product/knowledge-management-for-beginners) course (**€69.99**), [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) Premium (**€129.99**), [Obsidian Starter Course](/product/obsidian-starter-course) (**€69.99**), [AI Ghostwriter Guide](/product/ai-ghostwriter-guide) (**€49.99**), [PKM Library](/product/pkm-library) (**€39.99**), [Knowii Voice AI](/product/knowii-voice-ai) (**€49**), all workshops ([Clarity 101](/product/clarity-101), [Personal Organization 101](/product/personal-organization-101), [Journaling Deep Dive](/product/journaling-deep-dive), [AI Master Prompt](/product/ai-master-prompt), [MCP course](/product/model-context-protocol)), and all future additions. **Complete system, lifetime access**.

data.question: What about future products?
data.answer: Included automatically at no extra cost. When new workshops, courses, guides, or tools are added to the Knowledge products catalog, they're added to your account.

data.question: How is this different from Knowii Community subscription?
data.answer: Different philosophies for different people. The Everything Knowledge Bundle is for independent learners who want **ownership**: one-time payment, lifetime access, self-paced learning, no community obligations. [Knowii Community](/product/knowii-community) is for those who want **live interaction**: monthly subscription, live events, AMAs, real-time expert access, active community. Choose bundle if you prefer owning over renting, and private learning over community engagement.

data.question: Will the price increase?
data.answer: Yes. As more products are added to the bundle, the price will increase to reflect the growing value. The current price of **€299.99** is the lowest it will ever be. **Lock in today's price** and get all future additions at no extra cost.

data.question: I already own some products. Can I get a discount?
data.answer: Yes. Contact support with proof of your previous purchases for upgrade pricing. We'll calculate a fair discount based on what you already own.

data.question: Do I need all these products? Where should I start?
data.answer: Start wherever makes sense for you. New to PKM? Begin with [Knowledge Management for Beginners](/product/knowledge-management-for-beginners). Want to build your `Obsidian` system? Start with the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) and [Course](/product/obsidian-starter-course). Ready for AI-powered content creation? Jump into the [AI Ghostwriter Guide](/product/ai-ghostwriter-guide) and [Voice AI](/product/knowii-voice-ai). The bundle gives you complete coverage. Use what you need now, have the rest available when you're ready. **There's no wrong starting point**.

data.question: How do the products work together?
data.answer: They're designed to work together. [Knowledge Management for Beginners](/product/knowledge-management-for-beginners) teaches the principles (*PARA*, *Zettelkasten*, *Johnny Decimal*). The [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) implements those principles in a ready-to-use vault. The [Obsidian Starter Course](/product/obsidian-starter-course) shows you how everything connects. The [Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit) expands into **13 life areas**. The AI tools ([Ghostwriter](/product/ai-ghostwriter-guide) + [Voice AI](/product/knowii-voice-ai)) accelerate your content creation. The [PKM Library](/product/pkm-library) provides ongoing discovery.

data.question: Is there a money-back guarantee?
data.answer: Yes. If you're not satisfied, contact support for a full refund. No complicated process, no justification required.

data.question: How do I access everything after purchase?
data.answer: **Immediately after purchase**, all products appear in your account. Download everything right away or access them whenever you're ready. No drip-feeding, no unlock schedules. **It's all yours from day one**.

data.question: What if I'm new to Obsidian or knowledge management?
data.answer: Perfect. The bundle covers **beginner to advanced**. Start with [Knowledge Management for Beginners](/product/knowledge-management-for-beginners) (**10+ hours** of video covering fundamentals to AI integration), then move to the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) (ready-to-use vault set up in **30 minutes**) and [Course](/product/obsidian-starter-course) (**2.5 hours** of hands-on training). You don't need prior experience.

data.question: Will I get updates to existing products?
data.answer: Yes. **All updates and improvements** to all products included forever. When the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) gets a new version, you get it. When courses are updated, you get the updates. **Lifetime access means lifetime updates**.

data.question: I don't want to join a community. Is this still for me?
data.answer: This bundle was created **specifically for people like you**. No community obligations, no live events you need to attend, no public learning. Just you and the complete knowledge system, learning at your own pace, in your own space. **That's the whole point**.
